body:
## Background During the Qwen3-14B paged-attention migration to `aiv_shard`, assembling separate QK page tiles into columns of a wider Vec tile fails in the pinned A2/A3 toolchain. A 16-line standalone reproducer removes the model, shard/gather operations, runtime execution, and golden harness. PyPTO emits `pto.subview` plus `pto.tmov`, and PTOAS rejects that generated program. | Component | Reproduced version | |---|---| | pypto-lib | `0e7e07aa5e42db6e08c68fd5bfe1def571492b53` (`main`, with local Qwen experiments; full reproducer below) | | PyPTO | `9f657f37ed20ce148b46fb7229c267a152a0644e` (`main-test`, editable installation) | | simpler runtime | `4e4d3a4ad1e54c1db3d50e72decc025a9075bfa0` (detached, matches PyPTO gitlink) | | PTOAS | `0.57` (matches `toolchain/versions.env`) | | PTO ISA | `a8040450238f162985d8b596fbebeb54bfba2bf5` (detached, managed checkout matches runtime's `pto_isa.pin`) | | CANN | `9.0.0` | | Python / torch | `3.10.19` / `2.6.0+cpu` | | Host / target | Linux aarch64 / `a2a3` | The runtime source checkout and toolchain pins are consistent. The installed runtime binary's build revision was not independently stamped/verified. ### Component Codegen ### Description `pl.assemble(target, source, [0, 128])`, with FP32 Vec target `[16,512]` and source `[16,128]`, fails during PTOAS compilation: ```text 'pto.tmov' op expects A2/A3 non-mat tmov to use matching src/dst shapes ``` The public PyPTO [Vec assembly example](https://github.com/hw-native-sys/pypto/blob/9f657f37ed20ce148b46fb7229c267a152a0644e/examples/intermediate/05_assemble.py) documents column insertion. Reporting this against PyPTO Codegen because this supported source-level operation currently generates a program rejected by the pinned assembler. Whether the final fix belongs in the lowering or the PTOAS subview/TMOV contract remains to be determined. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Use the pinned environment above; source the CANN environment and set `PTOAS_ROOT` to the PTOAS 0.57 release root containing `ptoas.sh`. 2. Save the complete source below as `repro_vec_assemble.py`. 3. Run `python repro_vec_assemble.py`. No device allocation is required; `codegen_only=True` still invokes PTOAS.
Complete reproducer: repro_vec_assemble.py (save locally) ```python import torch import pypto.language as pl from pypto.runtime import RunConfig @pl.jit def assemble_columns(x: pl.Tensor[[16, 128], pl.FP32], out: pl.Out[pl.Tensor[[16, 512], pl.FP32]]): with pl.at(level=pl.Level.CORE_GROUP): source = pl.load(x, [0, 0], [16, 128], target_memory=pl.MemorySpace.Vec) target = pl.tile.full([16, 512], dtype=pl.FP32, value=0.0) result = pl.assemble(target, source, [0, 128]) pl.store(result, [0, 0], out) return out if __name__ == '__main__': assemble_columns.compile(torch.zeros(16, 128), torch.zeros(16, 512), config=RunConfig(platform='a2a3', codegen_only=True)) ```
### Expected Behavior Compilation succeeds for inserting the `[16,128]` tile into columns 128 through 255 of a zero `[16,512]` Vec tile. If this target-specific assembly form is unsupported, emit a source-level diagnostic explaining the restriction. ### Actual Behavior ```text Failed to compile function 'assemble_columns_incore_0': ptoas compilation failed: error: 'pto.tmov' op expects A2/A3 non-mat tmov to use matching src/dst shapes ``` Generated PTO excerpt, with source-location annotations removed: ```mlir %target__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c8192_i64 valid_row = %c16_index valid_col = %c512_index : !pto.tile_buf pto.texpands ins(%cst_7 : f32) outs(%target__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf) %assemble_view = pto.subview %target__ssa_v0[%c0_index, %c128_index] sizes [16, 128] valid [%c16_index, %c128_index] : !pto.tile_buf -> !pto.tile_buf pto.tmov ins(%source__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf) outs(%assemble_view : !pto.tile_buf) ``` Both printed TMOV operand types have logical dimensions `[16,128]`, while the destination view originates from a `[16,512]` allocation. A physical layout/pitch restriction is a hypothesis, not an independently established root cause. ### Git Commit ID `9f657f37ed20ce148b46fb7229c267a152a0644e` ### NPU Kind Other: `a2a3` compiler target. This reproducer only compiles; it does not execute on a device. ### Host Platform Linux (aarch64) ### Additional Context The lowering entry point is `MakeTileAssembleCodegenPTO` in `src/backend/common/pto_ops_datamove.cpp`. In the Qwen candidate, concatenating page results with `pl.concat` avoids this assembly failure and the tested output/cache comparisons pass. That workaround does not establish correctness of arbitrary column insertion or resolve this compiler/toolchain issue.
